user.title: Configure optimizer connections
user.description: Select the Heating Analytics forecast, heat-pump energy, buying-price, and feed-in-price entities. EPEX total-price sensors can be used for buying price; select the same entity for feed-in price when no separate export price is available.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure optimizer connections
reconfigure.description: Change the source entities. Optimization parameters remain available under Configure.

data.heat_energy_entity: Measured slab heat energy entity (cumulative kWh)

init.title: Optimizer options
init.description: Tune the optimization horizon, refresh rate, slab model, solar forecasts, allowed powers, heat pump dynamics, and COP table.

data.open_meteo_solar_entities: Open-Meteo Solar Forecast daily sensors (one per installation)
data.bootstrap_power_w: Power to hold in current quarter when no saved plan exists (W)
data.cop_table: COP table: first row the electrical powers (W); each further row an outdoor temperature (°C) followed by the COP at each power. Values in between are interpolated.
data.max_heat_kw: Maximum heat output of the heat pump (kW, 0 = no limit); power levels whose predicted heat exceeds it are skipped
data.start_profile_w: Start-up profile: mean electrical power (W) in each quarter after a start, comma-separated, whatever the target (empty = none)
data.ramp_up_w_per_quarter: Maximum rise of the mean electrical power per quarter while running (W, 0 = no limit)
data.ramp_down_w_per_quarter: Maximum fall of the mean electrical power per quarter while running (W, 0 = no limit; stopping is always immediate)
data.electrical_power_entity: Measured electrical power of the heat pump (W), to start the plan from what it draws now
data.compressor_running_entity: Compressor running sensor, to know how long the current run has lasted
data.power_change_cost_eur_per_kw: Penalty per kW change of the delivered power while running (EUR/kW)
data.plan_change_cost_eur_per_kw: Penalty per kW deviation from the previous plan (EUR/kW)
data.plan_change_hours: How far ahead deviations from the previous plan are penalised (hours)

error.slab_max_not_above_min: Maximum slab energy must be greater than minimum slab energy.
error.initial_slab_out_of_range: Initial slab energy must be between the minimum and maximum.
error.terminal_reserve_out_of_range: Terminal reserve must be between the minimum and maximum.
error.invalid_power_levels: Enter non-negative whole-number power levels separated by commas.
error.invalid_cop_table: Enter a header row of at least two increasing powers, then at least two rows of a temperature followed by one positive COP per power.
error.invalid_start_profile: Enter positive powers in W separated by commas, or leave empty.
